messages:
Olivia: Heads-up: Console PM requested a "policy preview" feature that simulates routing policy effects (quota delta, estimated latency, priority changes) for a subset of traffic before we rollout. They want SDKs to emit a tiny opt-in header to let Console correlate sampled requests.
Raj: Important: this must be telemetry-only. No routing or decisioning should change server-side unless a separate server-side canary is explicitly enabled.
Priya: Proposal for SDKs: add an optional constructor flag `previewRouting:true` (or env var) to emit `x-rwd-policy-preview:1` and a short sample id header `x-rwd-policy-preview-id:<hex>`.
Dmitri: Throttling note: for high-throughput clients we should limit emission to N headers per interval (token-bucket). Otherwise clients with heavy fanout will generate too many sample ids.
Olivia: Example usage (JS):
```ts
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, previewRouting: true })
```
Priya: Python example:
```py
from redwood import Redwood
client = Redwood(api_key=os.getenv('RW_KEY'), preview_routing=True)
```
Raj: And Go (opts):
```go
cli := redwood.NewClient(redwood.WithAPIKey(os.Getenv("RW_KEY")), redwood.WithPreviewRouting(true))
```
Dmitri: Telemetry: emit an event `policy_preview.opt_in` with {sdk, version, enabled} so we can measure adoption. Also add trace fields `policy_preview.sample_id` and `policy_preview.eval_key` to existing envelope rather than a new schema.
Olivia: Security: sample ids must be ephemeral and non-PII. Document this clearly and avoid including tenant ids in the header.
Priya: Rollout plan suggestion: feature off by default. Enable via env var `REDWOOD_POLICY_PREVIEW_RATE` (0-1) per SDK to control sampling fraction. Default 0.
Raj: Semver: this is opt-in and can be a minor bump. But call out breaking risk: some customers capture headers; we must ensure headers are small and opt-in.
Dmitri: Tests: unit tests for header presence/absence, sampler boundary cases, throttle behavior across concurrent requests.
Olivia: Console UX ask: show a "Preview (sampled)" badge and a small card comparing baseline vs previewed metrics for the sampled requests. Also allow tenant-wide vs user-scoped preview toggles.
UX-bot: UX team will produce a mock by Friday. Noted: include clear copy about opt-in and sampling.
Priya: Docs: add migration note: "previewRouting is opt-in, does not change routing unless server canary enabled." Add examples for py/ts/go and env setup.
Raj: Backcompat: if SDKs don't set the flag, nothing changes. If set, only new headers added. No header renames.
Dmitri: Dev infra: add a lightweight console endpoint that can accept preview headers in dev-only mode so Console can render card in staging without affecting prod routing.
CI-bot: scheduled canary build queued: policy-preview-canary-17460012 :rocket:.
Olivia: Timeline: aim for beta in 2 weeks. JS and Py first, Go shortly after. I'll open an RFC and a tracking issue. Thanks all :thumbsup:
